decisions.decision: The minutes of 4/4/2011 were reviewed and approved (no motion or vote count recorded).
decisions.quote: the minutes for 4/4/2011 were reviewed and approved.

decisions.decision: M.Benson will correct the Planning Board's webpage for the Task Force to show the current members.
decisions.quote: m.benson will correct the planning board's webpage for the task force updating the current members.

decisions.decision: J. McQuaid will follow up with the Primary School teachers for ideas for an educational brochure; goals to be set after an impact study week.
decisions.quote: j. mcquaid will follow up with the teachers for ideas to incorporate into an educational brochure.

decisions.decision: D. Blatt will evaluate bids with J. Londa to check for minimum qualifications; the Task Force will then select 3-4 bidders to recommend to the Town Manager.
decisions.quote: the task force will review the list and select 3-4 to recommend to the town manager.

decisions.decision: J. Breault will consult with the Fire department about whether solar hot water is feasible.
decisions.quote: j. breault will consult with the fire department about hot water use

decisions.decision: A recommendation on becoming a Green Community, with pros and cons, is to be made to the Board of Selectmen.
decisions.quote: a recommendation needs to be made to the board of selectmen with pros and cons of becoming a green community.

decisions.decision: Z. Cutting will write up a report on his home energy audit so it can be promoted to homeowners.
decisions.quote: he will write up a report so we can promote it to homeowners.

decisions.decision: J.Londa will put out a bid for a lighting upgrade for Town Hall and Ritter Building.
D. Blatt will evaluate whether a separate town-wide paper recycling bin would be profitable once the Town signs a new recycling contract.
decisions.quote: d. blatt said he could evaluate if a separate town wide paper recycling bin would be profitable
